latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of agent-rate-limiter.  
Prevents hitting API rate limits with adaptive throttling, tiered usage gates, and exponential backoff—no dependencies.

- Provides command-line tools to gate, record, and monitor API usage in a rolling window.
- Supports tier-based system (ok, cautious, throttled, critical, paused) to adjust agent behavior dynamically.
- Handles both proactive throttling and auto-pause/resume on real 429 errors using exponential backoff.
- Zero external dependencies; requires only Python and a local JSON state file.
- Includes conservative, configurable presets for Claude and OpenAI APIs; supports customization.
